title: SupremeAI Studio Dashboard — Federation Status & Live Agent Telemetry Contracts
description: Layer-5 (Frontend & Client UI) contract for SupremeAI Studio: one DashboardSnapshot document carrying (a) DesignTokens — the dark-mode glassmorphism palette (hex colors + rgba glass surfaces), typography scale, radii and micro-animation motion values, so every rendered surface is token-driven rather than ad-hoc; (b) FederationStatus — per-repo health for the multi-repo federation (closed health/ci_status enums, open PR/issue counters, RFC 3339 last_sync); and (c) AgentTelemetryCard — live agent telemetry (closed state enum, progress 0-100, token spend, last_event instant). Design guidelines (fast/accessible/responsive) are normative here: renderers MUST honor prefers-reduced-motion (disable non-essential animation), MUST keep body text contrast >= 4.5:1 against the glass surface, MUST keep all interactive targets >= 44px, MUST be keyboard-operable with visible focus indicators, and MUST use a mobile-first fluid grid (single column < 640px, two columns >= 640px, three+ >= 1024px). Performance budget: first paint with zero third-party network requests (vanilla JS/CSS only, fonts system-stack). Fail-closed: enums are closed, counters bounded, instants carry an explicit RFC 3339 pattern (format is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12), and unknown fields are rejected everywhere (additionalProperties false). The reference renderer lives in examples/dashboard-preview/ (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, zero dependencies) and validates its embedded snapshot against these constraints at boot, rendering a fail-closed error banner on any violation. See issue #24.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this contract document.

generated_at.description: Snapshot instant, explicit RFC 3339 pattern (format is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12).

agents.description: Live agent telemetry cards; bounded to keep render cost O(1) per frame budget.

DesignTokens.description: Token-driven design surface: renderers map these values 1:1 onto CSS custom properties. Colors are dark-mode-first; glass surfaces are rgba so the backdrop blur shows through.

surface_glass.description: Glass card surface: rgba(...) with alpha < 1 so backdrop-filter blur is visible.

text_primary.description: Primary text; normative contrast >= 4.5:1 on surface_glass-over-bg_base.

text_secondary.description: Secondary/muted text; normative contrast >= 4.5:1 for body, >= 3:1 for large text.

accent.description: Primary accent (live states, progress, focus rings).

accent_soft.description: Soft accent for gradients and glows.

font_sans.description: System sans stack (zero network font requests).

font_mono.description: System mono stack for ids, counters, code.

token.description: Type-scale token name (e.g. display, title, body, caption).

size.description: Font size in px or rem.

easing.description: Standard easing curve; renderers MUST disable non-essential motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

FederationStatus.description: Multi-repo federation health for the status board.

health.description: Closed health vocabulary; unknown is a valid state (fail-honest), not an error.

last_sync.description: Last federation sync instant, explicit RFC 3339 pattern.

AgentTelemetryCard.description: One live agent telemetry card. Vocabulary aligns with the telemetry-log and websocket-events contracts.

state.description: Closed agent state; drives card accent and the live pulse.

progress.description: Task progress percentage; drives the progress bar.

tokens_used.description: Cumulative token spend for this agent.

last_event.description: Last event instant, explicit RFC 3339 pattern.
